Express Entry draw update

IRCC has updated its express entry draw update page.

• #: Each round has a unique number given to it. You can use this to look up detailed results of each round.
• Date: The date the round was held.
• General rounds of invitations: In general rounds of invitations, we invite top-ranking candidates in the pool.

Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/corporate/mandate/policies-operational-instructions-agreements/ministerial-instructions/express-entry-rounds.html

Questions? Contact Hannan at INTRAWORLD.
